correctness.rationale: TARGET universal tremor-ball equality is unproved and Lemma 2 is false as stated. Lemma 2/B2 claim every aperiodic U-orbit in E_D (D!=4) is dense in E_D; square-D E_D contain Veech Teich curves, and a Veech surface rotated to a minimal uniquely-ergodic direction has no horizontal saddle connection (hence aperiodic) but U-closure inside the Teich curve, not E_D. Draft's curve-avoidance sentence reverses set vs direction logic. Lemma 4 fiber-filling (one essential direction spreads by horocycle averaging plus KZ-irreducibility to full |L|-ball, convexity, rotation-invariance, *-symmetry, propagation to all q) omits all renormalization computations and is asserted, not proved; it upgrades Chaika-Smillie-Weiss existence to universality without proof. Lemma 3 mass-equality/lower-semicontinuity and Lemma 5 properness plus strict-nesting minimal-presentation uniqueness (two presentations differ by T E_D absolute class) are cited or asserted. Toy script checks only R^n addition/commutation/nesting, not dynamics. Hence essential inferences fail; this is proof-gap plus false lemma, not a bounded fix.

originality.rationale: Nearest priors inspected at body level do not state or imply the submitted universal D!=4 ball equality. Chaika-Smillie-Weiss Annals 2026 proves nested distinctness for E (Thm 1.6) and existence of one q1 with closure equal to the a-tremor ball for E=E4 (Thm 1.8 via Baire), with only Remark 1.7/8.5 extending Thm 1.6 to other E_D, not the universal for-all-q0 ball description for all D!=4. Bainbridge-Smillie-Weiss classifies U-measures/closures inside E_D pre-tremor and contains no tremor-ball result. No synonymous-notation, broader-census, or database source covering all-D universal balls was found. The stronger universal quantifier is therefore new as a claim, even though its proof fails.

value.rationale: The headline, if true, would advance a recognized program: exact horocycle orbit-closure description for essential tremors over eigenform loci E_D, with radius invariant and strictly nested chain, generalizing the E4 spiky-fish picture to all D!=4. Object (E_D, essential balanced tremors, |L| radius) and invariant (closure equals B_a) were motivated before computation by the target and prior tremor program, are not textbook restatements, parameter substitutions, or tiny gains, and would be retrievable by future researchers. Value is independent of the correctness failure.
